text: I type a prompt, it breaks into tokens and a text embedding,
then a first-frame latent waits while the model starts remembering.
Noise comes in, then denoise steps, guided till the frames all line up,
decode it out, last frame slides forward, still by still it keeps us up.
Scale it, crop it, stitch the strips together, titles on top,
then sound comes in like a late train pulling into the stop.
